breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the inconsistency. The incomplete prompt incorrectly requested both a "gamma-centered k-point grid" and a "half shift". These are mutually exclusive options. The ground truth resolved this by removing the request for a "half shift". The generated specification repeated the error by asking for a "gamma-centered Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid with a half shift", which is a contradictory and invalid instruction.
